current_date: 2025-05-23 ('Updated 23.05.2025' on the checklist links on the council's Validation checklists page)
current_evidence: The council's Validation checklists page links 20 type-specific local validation checklists, most titled 'Updated 23.05.2025'. Grokbot's PDF is one of them (the combined 'Full Planning Permission And Advertisement Consent' checklist), and the page shows no newer version or consultation.

issues.detail: Stroud's local list is a set of 20 application-type checklists. The workbook URL points to just one of them, the combined 'Full Planning Permission and Advertisement Consent' checklist, which only applies when both are sought together. The workbook should link the Validation checklists page, or at least the standalone 'Full Planning Permission' checklist (media/54zb02my/...).
issues.evidence: Document title: 'Local validation checklist - Full Planning Permission and Advertisement Consent'; page lists separate Householder, Full, Outline, RM, LBC, Advert, LDC, Prior approval, NMA, s73, Discharge, Tree checklists

issues.detail: List date 2025-05-01 is from PDF metadata (CreationDate). The council labels the checklists 'Updated 23.05.2025', so the date should be 2025-05-23. The PDF text has no date of its own.
issues.evidence: Link titles on the Validation checklists page: 'Local Validation Checklist Full Planning Permission Updated 23.05.2025'

issues.detail: The council tab captures no actual requirements, only 2 process sentences: 'If an invalid application is submitted, Officers will set out what further information is required in writing' and 'Any application that remains invalid after 21 days will be returned and an administration fee charged.' The 24-item Local Requirement List is absent from tab_items.

Several local requirements on the Full/Outline/RM checklists are missing from Grokbot's Full planning, Outline and Reserved matters rows. (1) Biodiversity Survey: where development, including offsite works, affects designated sites, priority habitats, other biodiversity features or protected/priority species. It is also on the Householder and LBC checklists, so it is missing from every app type. (2) Surface Water Drainage Strategy: all major development (10+ dwellings or 1000 sqm+). (3) Transport Assessment: proposals likely to have significant highway implications; only Travel Plan was captured. (4) Air Quality Assessment (no trigger stated). (5) Sustainability Checklist. (6) Agricultural/Forestry Dwelling Justification: agricultural or forestry dwelling proposals (SDLP CP15). (7) Archaeological Assessment: new buildings or ground disturbance on or adjoining a heritage asset of archaeological importance. It is missing under Full planning and Outline.
issues.evidence: Full planning checklist Local Requirement List items 2, 3, 4, 5, 20, 21, 22

issues.detail: The Householder checklist (media/ba2bgzer) local list includes Biodiversity Survey and Tree Survey, but neither appears in Grokbot's Householder rows. Tree Survey applies to work within 15m of a TPO tree or in a Conservation Area, or within 10m of other trees 5m+ tall or 250mm+ trunk diameter, to BS 5837.
issues.evidence: Householder Local Requirement List: Archaeological Assessment; Biodiversity Survey; CIL; Daylight/Sunlight; Flood Risk Assessment; Heritage Statement; Tree Survey

issues.detail: Advertisement consent rows (28) were taken almost entirely from the combined Full Planning + Advertisement Consent checklist. They therefore list Affordable Housing, Environmental Statement, Travel Plan, Statement of Community Involvement, Viability, Site Waste Management Plan, CIL, Noise, Contaminated Land, Retail Impact and others. The standalone Advertisement Consent checklist's local list is only Heritage Statement (where a heritage asset may be affected), Lighting Assessment (floodlighting or significant external lighting) and Other plans (architectural features / streetscene).
issues.evidence: Advertisement Consent checklist (media/oulhveis): local requirements = Heritage Statement, Lighting Assessment, Other plans; Affordable Housing, Travel Plan, ES, SCI, Viability, SWMP 'do not appear'

issues.detail: Listed building consent rows (26) mostly come from the combined Full Planning + LBC checklist. They therefore list Affordable Housing, CIL, Travel Plan, Retail/Town Centre Impact, Viability, Site Waste Management Plan, Noise, Contaminated Land and LVIA, none of which apply to LBC. The standalone LBC checklist (media/u1ebxlda/listed-building-consent.pdf, not read by Grokbot) has national items DAS, a Heritage Statement with full schedule of works, and 1:20 joinery details. Its local list is Archaeological Assessment, Biodiversity Survey, Other plans (architectural/joinery details at 1:20 or larger), Photographs and Structural Survey.
issues.evidence: LBC checklist Local Requirement List items 10-14; 'Not mentioned: Affordable Housing, CIL, Travel Plan, Retail Impact, Viability, Site Waste Management Plan, Noise, and Contaminated land'

issues.detail: Householder rows come from the combined Householder + LBC checklist, so they include LBC-only content. The standalone Householder checklist has no Structural Survey. The Householder 'Heritage Statement' trigger quoted ('Must include a full schedule of proposed works') is the LBC wording; the householder trigger is 'Required if the proposed development may affect a designated or undesignated heritage asset'.
issues.evidence: Householder checklist: 'Structural Survey: No. The checklist does not mention one.'

issues.detail: Many trigger excerpts are fragments or text from the wrong item. Householder DAS = 'formulation of design and access statements.' (real: only in a Conservation Area for 1+ dwelling / 100 sqm new floorspace, or with LBC). Householder site levels = 'Ground levels should also be taken into account in the formulation of design and access statements.' Outline 'Existing and proposed site levels' quotes Tree Survey text ('within 15m of any tree protected by a TPO'). Prior approval 'Existing and proposed site levels' quotes the Biodiversity Survey text. Prior approval 'Structural Survey' = 'operations (including structural surveys) Evidence of existing use of the site'. Retail = 'commercial sites. Retail impact assessment (RIA) in compliance with SDLP Policy EI9.' (real: commercial uses outside identified centres, extensions to commercial sites, retail floorspace). Street scene = 'architectural features Streetscene'. Advertisement drawings = 'projection and illumination details.' Daylight excerpts are prefixed with stray 'Priority Species' / 'Forms available at'.
issues.evidence: app_type_rows trigger_excerpt fields vs checklist triggers

issues.detail: Some requirements are mislabelled or have incomplete triggers. (1) 'Waste / Refuse and recycling storage details' is actually the Site Waste Management Plan, for major development only (10+ dwellings or residential sites over 0.5ha; non-residential over 1000 sqm or 1ha+), not bin storage details. (2) 'Planning Obligations / S106' quotes only the CIL Form 1/Form 2 sentence; the S106 element (heads of terms, costs undertaking, solicitor details, proof of title where developer contributions are needed) is lost. (3) LVIA omits that it is mandatory within or affecting the Cotswolds AONB / National Landscape.
issues.evidence: 'Site Waste Management Plan Required for any major development proposals: 10+ dwellings or residential development on sites over 0.5ha...'; LVIA 'mandatory for sites within or affecting the Cotswold AONB'

issues.detail: There are duplicated excerpts. The CIL row and the Planning Obligations / S106 row share the same CIL Form text across Full, Outline, RM, LBC and Advert. Under Lawful development cert, 'Lawful development evidence', 'Photographs / Photomontages' and 'Roof plan' all quote the same 'date stamped photographs, statutory declarations, date stamped bills and invoices' evidence text.

Grokbot did not read 5 of the 20 checklists: Discharge of Conditions, Non Material Amendment, Removal/Variation of Conditions, standalone Listed Building Consent and Tree Applications. It still marked those types '(none)'. The s73 checklist was checked and has no Local Requirement List, so '(none)' is right there. LBC is wrong (see above), and the other three were not verified.

summary: Grokbot's link is current: Stroud's checklists were updated 23.05.2025, though the workbook records 2025-05-01. But it points to one combined Full + Advert checklist rather than the 20-checklist set, and the tab holds only two process sentences. App-type rows taken from combined checklists put full-planning items (affordable housing, travel plan, CIL, etc.) under Advertisement consent and LBC. They also miss Biodiversity Survey, Surface Water Drainage Strategy, Transport Assessment, Air Quality, Sustainability Checklist and Agricultural Dwelling Justification.
